name: 33713 · St Petersburg, FL
findings: ZIP 33713 (St Petersburg) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33713 (St Petersburg) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
